question: For veg whsle data, can you generate a summary of our items' loss rates? Include the average loss rate, and also break down the count of items that are below, above, and within one standard deviation from this average.
sql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG("loss_rate_%") AS avg_loss_rate,
    STDDEV("loss_rate_%") AS std_dev_loss_rate
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
  WHERE "loss_rate_%" IS NOT NULL
),
items AS (
  SELECT "loss_rate_%" 
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df 
  WHERE "loss_rate_%" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(ANY_VALUE(s.avg_loss_rate), 2) AS avg_loss_rate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i."loss_rate_%" < s.avg_loss_rate - s.std_dev_loss_rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS below_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i."loss_rate_%" >= s.avg_loss_rate - s.std_dev_loss_rate AND i."loss_rate_%" <= s.avg_loss_rate + s.std_dev_loss_rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i."loss_rate_%" > s.avg_loss_rate + s.std_dev_loss_rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS above_count
FROM items i
CROSS JOIN stats s
